J1.evidence: Source: 'أي: وَعَلَيْكَ قرآن الفَجْر' (i.e. [hold to] the recitation/Qur'an of dawn). TR gloss '(sabah namazındaki Kur'an okumaya da devam et)' renders عليك acceptably (devam et = hold to), but adds 'namazındaki' (in the morning PRAYER), an interpretation not in the Arabic, which only says قرآن الفجر. Unmarked interpretive addition; should be 'sabahın Kur'an'ına (okunuşuna) da devam et' or the prayer reading put in [Mütercim notu: ...].

J2.evidence: Arabic: 'أي: وَعَلَيْكَ قرآن الفَجْر' (i.e. [hold to] the Quran/recitation of dawn). TR gloss '(sabah namazındaki Kur'an okumaya da devam et)' adds unmarked 'sabah namazındaki' (prayer is not in the text) and an interpretive 'devam et'. Should be a literal gloss, with any interpretation in [Mütercim notu: …].

tr.fixed_note: Literal gloss of وعليك قرآن الفجر; the 'sabah namazı' interpretation moved into a Mütercim notu
tr.verify_note: Gloss of 'وعليك قرآن الفجر' is now literal ('fecrin Kur'ân'ı da senin üzerine olsun'); the morning-prayer interpretation is inside a Mütercim notu; nothing unmarked added.
